us_coverage.policy: After all v43 draws, equal negative phrase/preset/uniform sorted eligible variant; all other slots/RNG unchanged

temporal.policy: One independent end per chosenUSexample;8positive+6negative uniform complete ends,6negative uniform fulltimeline;source draws unchanged

balanced_coverage.policy: After all v45 draws, equal negative phrase/numeric allowedID/uniform9variants; other slots/RNG unchanged

temporal.policy: One independent end per chosenbalancedexample;8positive+6negative uniform complete ends,6negative uniform fulltimeline;source draws unchanged

complete_coverage.feature_environment: Pinned Mac saved uint16 features; measured Linux frontend differences retained
complete_coverage.policy: Equal phrase for negatives, engine, conditioning identity, canonical WAV, variant; aliases once. Original British draws occur first; remaining British/ambient slots untouched.

negative_timeline.policy: Uniform integer end150..len(raw),24 candidate negatives only

positive_timeline.policy: Uniform end crop_end..min(350,len(raw)),16 candidate positives only; conservative original sample ledger

negative_container_mixture.policy: Consume all v42 timeline draws, override first12 negative ends uniformly crop_end..min(350,len(raw))

validation_detection: latched events after full receptive-field warmup

full_source.policy: Replace first80 phrase slots with complete-source crops; equal checkpoint groups before voices, equal negative phrase choice. Original48 ambient slots/weights retained; no supplementary BCE or head. Groups do not certify physical-person independence.

label_smoothing_policy: Training BCE targets y*(1-epsilon)+epsilon/2; sample weights unchanged; evaluation labels/windows unchanged
mask_prefix_loss_policy: Zero weight on all sampled prefix slots only; inputs, label placeholders, other weights and RNG draws unchanged; no claim of verified phonetic completeness

prefix_negatives.policy: Training-positive crops ending 150..350ms before unchanged keyword_frame; replace confusing-negative slots; baseline RNG unchanged; label0 weight20. Endpoint is an energy proxy, not phone timing.

spec_augment.policy: One mask per enabled axis per training sample; width uniform inclusive 0..maximum; independent RNG; disabled for validation and INT8 calibration

mining_policy: Training-only highest-scoring window per sampled confusing-negative row; baseline RNG preserved; disabled for INT8 calibration
selection: Float continuous validation <=0.5 ambient events/h and <=1% confusing clips per source; then maximize mean source recall. Quantized validation must be recalibrated.
scope: Research candidate. Same v1 evaluation sets are development regressions; real-user acceptance remains unmeasured.
